limitations: Narrow Cross-Sectional Breadth (N = 19 Stocks): Each monthly cross-section has 19 stocks. Under H0: IC_t = 0, a single month’s Spearman Rank IC has approximate standard error 1/sqrt(19-2) = 0.2425. A Top-5 portfolio holds 5/19 = 26.3% of the universe.

Fixed-Universe Selection: The evaluated panel contains 19 stocks, not a point-in-time Nifty 100 universe. Selection history is not recorded in the data artifacts, so survivorship and selection bias cannot be quantified.
Price and Volume Technical Scope Only: Features are derived exclusively from daily OHLCV market data without quarterly fundamental accounting ratios.
Fixed Chronological Split: Final evaluation uses the Jul 2022–Nov 2024 test window; results do not establish performance in other periods or market regimes.
